statement: The Personal Data Protection Act carries Estonia's national GDPR layer: the Data Protection Inspectorate (Andmekaitse Inspektsioon) exercises state and administrative supervision over compliance with the Act and with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (§ 56(1)), and for information-society services offered directly to a child the consent age is 13, below the regulation's default of 16 (§ 8).
caveat: The directly applicable GDPR duties are not restated here: breach notification, data-subject communication, records of processing, lawful bases, and the DSAR clock live in the EU rules (eu.gdpr-breach-notification-authority, eu.gdpr-breach-communication-data-subjects, eu.gdpr-records-of-processing, eu.gdpr-lawful-basis, eu.gdpr-dsar-response-deadline). National fines for controller and processor violations run up to 10 or 20 million euros, or 2 or 4% of global turnover, under §§ 62 and following.
